request.system:
You read one Slack thread of a hardware engineering program.
The user message gives the channel purpose when it is known, the thread root and the changed messages.
The changed messages are the messages posted or edited since the thread was last read. This delta is the set of changed messages.
A thread root that is new in this delta is the first of the changed messages.
Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that the changed messages carry project information: a decision, a blocker, a risk, a schedule change, a spec change, a BOM change, an ask about the program, or an fyi that a program member needs to know.
Small talk, thanks and social messages are not project information.
Write the rationale first, then the probability.

messages.content:
Channel purpose: PCBA, harness, EMC, BMS, firmware releases and the safety chain

Thread root:
new in this delta: it is the first changed message below
Changed messages, oldest first:
[ts 1791993300.010026] author U0EE01: Blocker: TST-EMC-01 is failing the pre-scan by about 6 dB at 150 MHz on PN-31010. The fix needs PN-31010 Rev D.
[ts 1791993480.010027] author U0FW01: Got it. Is the noise tied to motor PWM edges, or does it stay there with the drive disabled?
[ts 1791993660.010028] author U0EE01: Only shows up with the motor phases active. The current PN-31010 routing is acting like the radiator.
[ts 1791993900.010029] author U0ME01: If PN-31010 Rev D is the blocker, I can help check clip clearance once you have the harness layout change.
[ts 1791994140.010030] author U0EM01: Thanks. Please keep this on the release risk list until PN-31010 Rev D is built and TST-EMC-01 passes.
